note: Decision 275: chases on foot. An abstract track: the gap runs 0 (caught) to `gap.max` (lost them), starting at `gap.start`. A chase runs in legs; in each leg every crew member makes one move (one roll — it counts for its own effect and towards keeping pace) and the pursuers make one move (the GM rolls once). The crew keeps pace as a group check (decision 271: half must succeed). Crew succeeds / pursuers fail: +1 (+2 if everyone succeeded); crew fails / pursuers succeed: −1 (−2 on the pursuers' margin of `bigMargin` or more); both succeed: it holds; both fail: it holds and the complication bites whoever failed. Pursuers who shoot don't close the gap that leg. A successful Lead gives the crew `lead` on next leg's rolls; a successful Cover fire or Hack gives the pursuers `spoil` next leg (a Hack takes out their drone first). Hide works from a gap of `gap.hideFrom` with no drone overhead, when everyone hides and the group succeeds. Failing `behindAfter` legs in a row: the GM may leave someone behind. From leg `fatigue.fromLeg` every failure also costs +`fatigue.strain` Strain and a CON roll (failure: `fatigue.fail`). A faster pursuer gets `fast`. Rules: rules/chase.js.
